ideas.title: Investigating ICE Officer Conduct
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent allegations of perjury and untruthful statements made by ICE officers
questions: What is the extent of the issue with ICE officer conduct?
How will the investigations into ICE officer conduct affect the agency's reputation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues within ICE and hold officers accountable for their actions.
